localContext: Whitestone's tree-lined streets, proximity to the waterfront, and abundance of gardens and flowering landscapes create ideal nesting conditions for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees, especially during spring and summer months. Paper wasp nests appear under eaves and porch overhangs; yellow jackets build inside wall voids and underground burrows; bald-faced hornets construct large aerial nests in trees and shrubs; carpenter bees drill nesting galleries into the wooden trim, fascia, and deck railings common throughout the Tudor-style homes near Malba and the established neighborhoods along 14th Avenue.
